## Index record

- **ID:** REM-0007
- **Title:** Protective-stop coverage race: stop sized from a stale position read
- **Date:** 2026-09-22
- **Status:** recorded in the hash-chained remediation ledger
- **Authority:** REMEDIATION
- **What was wrong:** On 2026-09-21 a BAC entry filled 229 shares at 19:48:20. Four seconds later /v2/positions still reported 219, _reconcile_protective_stops sized a GTC stop from that 219, and 10 shares had no protection for 17h42m across an overnight gap. The telemetry logged unprotected_remainder 0.0 because quantity and protectable both came from the SAME stale snapshot - the check certified itself.
- **Correction:** broker.order(id) added: the order is the authority for its own fill. _entry_fills_this_cycle reads filled_qty for this cycle's entries; _settled_position_quantity refuses to trust a position read BELOW a known fill and re-reads up to 3 times, never returning more than the broker has shown (a stop for uncredited shares is rejected outright). _verify_stop_coverage re-reads positions AND working orders after the loop and classifies each position fully_protected / partially_protected / unprotected / stop_pending_verification, counting only orders the broker says are RESTING.
- **Affects:** LIVE MONEY PATH - operational safety. No strategy rule changed.
- **Economic rules changed:** False
